title: Welcome, playtesters!
body:
Thank you for helping us playtest Disorder of the Stone!

It is still in development, so expect rough edges. Finding those is exactly what the playtest is for.

* Report bugs and share your feedback in #bug-reports, but check #known-issues first to avoid duplicates.

The playtest is not a public release (yet). Please refrain from sharing the modpack outside of the playtest server.
